description: This file is a C source code implementing a test provider for the rbus framework. It defines several data handlers for properties, including get and set handlers, and sets up two provider instances with specific data elements. The code includes callback functions for handling property value retrieval and setting, as well as a main function that registers data elements, runs for a specified duration, and then unregisters providers.

methods.name: rbusError_t getHandler1(rbusHandle_t handle,rbusProperty_t property,rbusGetHandlerOptions_t * opts)
methods.description: Handles get requests for a property, updates the value periodically between a min and max, and logs the call.

methods.name: rbusError_t getHandler2(rbusHandle_t handle,rbusProperty_t property,rbusGetHandlerOptions_t * opts)
methods.description: Provides a static integer value (10) for a property.

methods.name: rbusError_t SampleProvider_allTypesSetHandler(rbusHandle_t handle,rbusProperty_t prop,rbusSetHandlerOptions_t * opts)
methods.description: Handles set requests for properties, specifically tracks count for a particular property and simulates validation, logs each call.
